description: EPEX SPOT day-ahead electricity auction results for the Germany-Luxembourg bidding zone (DE-LU, Europe's largest power market) and a delivery day: baseload and peakload prices (EUR/MWh), and for every hour and every 15-minute period the price, buy volume, sell volume and traded volume (MWh). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

area.description: Bidding zone: DE-LU (the only zone the public page serves)

date.description: Delivery day YYYY-MM-DD within the last few days the public page keeps (default tomorrow after the noon auction, else today)

resolution.description: hour (default) or quarter for 15-minute periods too

name: energy_epex_spot_power_europe
title: Energy Epex Spot Power Europe
